section.title: Jurisdiction and Venue
section.para: Primary claims arise under California Labor Code and the ABC test (Lab. Code § 2775 et seq.). Subject matter jurisdiction in California Superior Court. Federal dimensions under NLRA (unfair labor practices) may invoke concurrent federal jurisdiction.

Constitutional scope: California statutory (ABC test application); federal statutory (NLRA); potentially federal constitutional (Supremacy Clause, preemption analysis if platform argues federal preemption).
Administrative exhaustion: Claims under FEHA require CRD complaint and right-to-sue letter before court filing. NLRA claims require NLRB charge filing.

section.title: Parties
section.para: Plaintiff: Ian D.L.N. McLean, individually and as member of affected class of platform users systematically misclassified as independent contractors or consumers rather than employees or service providers.
Defendants: [To be specified — Google LLC and related entities]
